display.title: Episode 546: Levi's Dream of the Third Beis HaMikdash (Rosh Hashanah)
display.summary_short: Uncle Yossi's show before Rosh Hashanah: why it is called the 'head' of the year, Shema with a studio guest, and a boy who dreams he flies to see the third Beis HaMikdash.
display.summary_long: Broadcast in the last week of Elul 5752, days before Rosh Hashanah. Uncle Yossi explains why our Sages call the day Rosh Hashanah, the head of the year, and not just its beginning: like the head of the body, it affects every day that follows. He reminds children to use a machzor, review the laws, and hear the shofar on both days, praying for the great shofar of Moshiach. After the Hakochainik march, a fifth-grade girl from a Brooklyn girls' school leads the Shema, and everyone gives tzedakah. Story time: little Levi learns in yeshiva that Hashem has built the third Beis HaMikdash in Heaven and lowers it a little with every mitzvah. That night he dreams that a spaceship, 'Flight 770', takes him to see it, but he stays too long and the ship leaves without him, until he wakes up in his own bed. Uncle Yossi then explains that the word Rebbe stands for 'Rosh Bnei Yisroel', the head of the Jewish people, and leads the children in Tehillim for the Rebbe's recovery. Candle-lighting times and holiday wishes close the show.
display.lesson: Every bit of Torah and every mitzvah brings the third Beis HaMikdash closer; and a good Rosh Hashanah, like a healthy head, sets the whole year right.

date.note: Shofar 'this coming Monday morning, September 28th, and Tuesday morning, September 29th' = Rosh Hashanah 5753; the Tuesday before is 22 Sep 1992. Prayers for the Rebbe's recovery fit 1992.
